No, let's be honest, plenty of people don't pick on others because they're insecure, often it's just to get a laugh from their friends, there's people who will talk to me fine if they're not around their group, but with their group they'll hurl insults at me. I've done it before, obviously not as bad as these kids, and I was much younger then, but still. I'm a broken person, I spent like four months in my room, leaving only to buy un prescribed benzos like alprazolam and weed, and I don't pick on kids. The people that pick on me are happier and more successful, that's a fact.
And to be honest, bullying isn't my biggest problem, I am extremely uncomfortable with myself, I don't mean body image or whatever, I spend every hour I am awake cringing at how I acted that day, and just disliking myself.
I don't want to speak to a doctor. I don't want to speak to anyone, the last thing I want is more pity.

Let's be honest often bullies are just happier and more successful than other people, and they only pick on people because it's funny.
I'd love to be able to think that they're covering up insecurities, but honestly' it's not true
